features.live_preview: authenticated desktop/tablet/mobile storefront and commerce-page preview implemented
features.mega_menu: portable definitions, menu-item binding, rich panel editor and accessible responsive renderer implemented
features.cart_checkout_blocks: public render_block outer-shell integration; native block internals remain untouched

notes: WooCommerce version ranges remain unset until the Phase 0 environment audit and compatibility matrix are completed.
The module extends public Theme hooks and does not patch Theme or WooCommerce source at runtime.
Rich mega-menu content and Commerce page-model choices are stored in the versioned customer profile and contain no executable PHP or JavaScript.
Cart and Checkout block internals are intentionally not targeted; model styling uses an IT-Kayali wrapper added at the public WordPress block-render boundary.
Responsive/RTL/accessibility browser coverage includes the Commerce page-model slice.
